caption: : Eval PPL. under different Shared Sub-Dim ratio settings.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the evaluation Perplexity Loss (PPL) for two models, Transformer and MoHD, as the ratio of shared sub-dimensions to total sub-dimensions is varied. The x-axis, labeled “Shared Sub-Dims / Total Sub-Dims,” uses a linear scale ranging from 0/4 to 4/4, with tick labels at each quarter interval. The y-axis, labeled “Eval PPL,” uses a linear scale ranging from 10.0 to 12.5, with tick marks at 0.5 intervals. The Transformer model is represented by a dashed orange line with circular markers, which remains nearly constant at a PPL value of approximately 11.75 across all x-axis values. The MoHD model is represented by a solid blue line with square markers, which begins at a PPL of approximately 11.15, decreases to a minimum of approximately 10.25 at the 3/4 mark, and then increases to approximately 10.75 at the 4/4 mark.
